findings.evidence: models/rfsv.py forecast() squares every finite positive volatility before calling forward(). For RFSV(.1).forecast([1e-200]), the square underflows to zero and forward() raises ValueError, although the previous log-volatility calculation accepted this input. This is outside the observed GK scale but narrows the retained public interface.
findings.fix: Keep the compatibility wrapper in log space, or guard the conversion so finite positive volatility inputs retain their former behavior; add one extreme-magnitude check.
